blurb: Dolphin Head Golf Club offers an 18-hole Gary Player-designed golf course with multiple teeing grounds and practice facilities. Guests can book tee times, take private or group golf lessons, and participate in memberships with exclusive benefits. The club also hosts golf outings and tournaments with full event coordination and amenities.
extraNote: Cancelations or changes must be made at least 8 hours prior to tee time to avoid fees · No-shows and short-shows may be charged up to 50% of green fee plus cart fee per absent player · Outside coolers and alcohol are not permitted on property · Rain checks issued if course closes or becomes unplayable, valid 12 months · Booking fees are non-refundable · Management may refuse play for improper attire · Cart rental responsibility for damage lies with renting golfer
